zones.title: Mock TIBCO ESB: POST /sales-orders
zones.body: Lab stand-in for the ESB endpoint that creates the SAP sales order. If esb_chaos has remaining failures for this order it answers 503 and decrements, so a fixture can rehearse the intake workflow's exponential backoff. Otherwise it records the order and answers 201 with a SAP number, idempotent on order_id.
